entries.en: to exchange; to swap
entries.notes: 词头书作 Procar.，本页通篇为 trocar 词簇，据换字与 vã 音写取交换义。

entries.en: to exchange; to change, barter
entries.notes: 音写 ee/eg 存疑且声调污損难辨（T99），据易字与 trocar 词头权取交换义。

entries.en: to substitute; to take another's place
entries.notes: 声调污損（T99）、音写 fo/to/ro 存疑，据代字与 trocar 语境权取替代义。

entries.zh: 典质、抵换（赘，以子抵钱；字或辨作贽＝初见贽礼）
entries.en: to pawn, pledge (a child) for payment; alt. reading zhi: an introductory gift
entries.notes: 西句 los hijos … pagadores 处潦草难辨，据赘/贽字义保守权衡：赘合古'赘子'典质之例。

entries.zh: 更迭、调换职事（oficio＝差事、行当）；字或辨作送（致送）
entries.en: to alternate, trade off one's office or trade; alt. reading: to send, deliver
entries.notes: 汉字送/迭辨识存疑，据 Trocar oficio 语境取更迭职事义。

entries.en: to exchange the bad for the good; to swap out, replace
to change over, convert; to exchange (object word garbullos uncertain)
entries.notes: garbullos/garvullos 拼写与词义存疑，据转字与 trocar 取转换义。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 整行潦草多处难辨（[残]），汉字窃/窍亦存疑，无从定夺。

entries.zh: 改；变改、迁易（trocar se＝mudarse：迁居、改换处所）
entries.en: to change (oneself); to move house, change one's abode
to change, alter; to move (to another place)
to change, alter

entries.zh: 改头；改换头面、变成另一模样
entries.en: to change one's appearance ('change the head'), appear in another guise
entries.notes: 'destra/de otra' 辨识存疑，据改头与 trocar se de otra manera 语境取改换头面义。

entries.zh: 改面；改头换面、改换面目
entries.en: to change one's face, alter one's appearance
entries.notes: otra 拼写潦草、bin 尾钩难辨，据改面字义取改换面目义。

entries.en: to change, correct, amend
to change, alter; to correct
entries.notes: 'corregido/corregir' 辨识存疑，据更变取变更义。

entries.zh: 交易；兑换（以整银换零钱）
entries.en: to trade; to exchange silver for small change
entries.notes: 'menuda' 拼写存疑且一处声调污損（T99），据交易与马尼拉兑银语境取兑换义。

entries.zh: 兑换；以银抵换他物（chapag 物名与托字皆辨识存疑）
entries.en: to exchange silver for (chapag: item name uncertain)
entries.notes: chapag~/chapay 与音写 to/fo 存疑，据 plata por 结构取兑换义。

entries.en: to take in exchange; to swap one thing for another
entries.notes: 西句第二行（odino oracoa）墨色极淡难辨（[残]），据首行 oro por otro 与交取二字取换释义。

entries.zh: 替换；更换、顶替（西文或为 se entabl[ad]ura，换铺板）
entries.en: to replace, substitute (object possibly planking or boards, reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 'seentabiadura/se en tabiadura' 拼写存疑，据替换取更换义。

entries.en: to change over, convert (gold for gold)

entries.zh: 换替；换易更替（以金易金）
entries.en: to exchange and replace, swap one for another
